import numpy as _n
_xs=_n.array([-1.5,-0.5,0.5,1.5])

    for _i in range(3):
        loc.append(_n.array([[_xs[_i],_xs[_j]],[_xs[_i+1],_xs[_j]],[_xs[_i+1],_xs[_j+1]],[_xs[_i],_xs[_j+1]]]))
VS=1.0
u=_n.zeros((9,4,2)); ud=_n.zeros((9,4,2)); udd=_n.zeros((9,4,2)); qnod=_n.zeros((9,4))
for _e,_xy in enumerate(loc):
    for _k in range(4):
        _x,_y=_xy[_k]
        u[_e,_k]=[0.30*_x+0.12*_x*_y+0.06*_y*_y, 0.18*_y+0.15*_x*_y+0.09*_x*_x]
        _vx=0.20*_y-0.10*_x; _vy=0.16*_x+0.05*_y
        ud[_e,_k]=[VS*_vx, VS*_vy]; udd[_e,_k]=[-0.6*VS*_vx,-0.6*VS*_vy]
    _r=_n.sqrt(_xy[:,0]**2+_xy[:,1]**2); qnod[_e]=(_r<=1.5).astype(float)
E=1.0;nu=0.3;rho=1.0
assert np.allclose(dynamic_j_integral(loc, u, ud, udd, qnod, E, nu, rho, False), target)
